column1: # benchmark/durations.tsv -- the durations of the published run, one line per part
# and machine.  Written by `make durations` (benchmark/tools/durations.py) from the
# run records; do not edit by hand.  `source`: record = TIMES.txt of the run (wall
# time of the runner, build excluded); slurm-wall = wall time of the batch job, build
# included; log = time stamps of the run's log.
